title: Root causes of closed incidents
question: Which root causes account for the most closed incidents?

sql_tasks.description: Calculate the count of closed incidents grouped by root cause, and order them in descending order to identify which root causes account for the most closed incidents.

tasks.description: Calculate the count of closed incidents grouped by root cause, and order them in descending order to identify which root causes account for the most closed incidents.
tasks.sql:
SELECT 
    root_cause, 
    COUNT(*) AS closed_incident_count
FROM incidents
WHERE status = 'closed'
GROUP BY root_cause
ORDER BY closed_incident_count DESC
